title: Pendle资管Amy：美债当前价值存疑，上行风险大于下行
speaker: Amy Xie Patrick

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, I'd actually push back and go, how do you assess that there is value in the treasury market right now? Because when I look at where yields are versus the direction that fundamentals are
segments.zh: 其实我想反驳一下：你现在凭什么判断国债市场有价值？因为当我看收益率水平与基本面方向时

segments.en: traveling in, you know, you could argue tactically right now we're in this area where for the risks
segments.zh: 从基本面走向看，可以说当前战术上我们处于这样一个区域：针对未来的风险

segments.en: in inflation and growth that we see ahead of us, the economic fundamentals that central banks care about yields have possibly priced in enough of near-term central bank action, so more hawkers
segments.zh: 在通胀和增长方面，央行关注的经济基本面，收益率可能已充分定价了近期的央行行动，比如更多鹰派

segments.en: rhetoric, more hikes to come. But have they priced enough of how much this can continue to escalate?
segments.zh: 言论和更多加息。但市场是否充分定价了这种升级能持续多久？

segments.en: So, what I'm trying to say is I think the upside risks in the medium term, so looking out three months to yields is probably, you know, higher than the downside risks. Unless you were to tell me that
segments.zh: 我想说的是，中期来看，未来三个月收益率的向上风险可能大于向下风险。除非你告诉我

segments.en: something so dramatic on regulation against, you know, AI or AI Catholics and those kinds of things
segments.zh: 针对AI或AI相关领域的监管出现戏剧性变化，这类事情

segments.en: can be so united on a bipartisan scale that it sort of crushes almost entrepreneurial spirit.
segments.zh: 能在两党层面如此一致，以至于几乎压制了创业精神。

segments.en: In the US and again, I see that as highly unlikely.
segments.zh: 在美国，我再次认为这极不可能。
